rationale: For an AI-powered Resume Builder, we need a high-converting, authoritative presence that builds trust immediately. A Swiss & High-Contrast archetype emphasizes clarity, function, and professionalism, shedding unnecessary decoration. It leans on stark contrasts, sharp typography, and realistic UI mockups to drive conversions.

layout.spacing_system: Generous. Use p-8, p-12, py-24, gap-8. Containers with borders MUST have padding to prevent collision.
layout.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-align dense content, center-align hero strictly if visually balanced, though asymmetrical left-aligned hero is preferred for SaaS.

surfaces.header: Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70, 1px border-white/40 inner stroke, shadow-sm
surfaces.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border-border, no shadow. Hover: -translate-y-1, shadow-lg, border-primary/20
surfaces.mockup_wrapper: High-fidelity CSS/HTML UI mockup inside the Hero section. Use a rounded-2xl container with a subtle shadow-2xl, border border-border/50, and a glass-like header bar mimicking a browser or app window.
surfaces.buttons: Sharp, pill-shaped or rounded-md. Primary: bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary/90. Secondary: bg-white border border-border hover:bg-muted.

motion.hover: Explicit hover states on all interactive elements (e.g., hover:bg-primary/90 hover:text-white).
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for Bento grid items.

components_strategy.marketing_sections: Pure HTML + Tailwind for structural layouts (Bento, Hero, Steps).
components_strategy.interactive: Shadcn components heavily customized (Buttons, Badges, Tabs for feature switching).
components_strategy.product_mockup: Do not use static images for the hero mockup. Construct a pseudo-UI using pure Tailwind/HTML to represent the AI chat on the left and the generated resume document on the right. This increases page quality.
components_strategy.icons: Use lucide-react for all standard iconography.

page_sections_instructions.header: Crystal Glassmorphism sticky header. Logo on left, nav links center, CTA right. No hamburger on desktop.
page_sections_instructions.hero: Short outcome-focused headline (<44 chars). Subtitle with high contrast. Primary sticky CTA. Followed by a massive, central product mockup built entirely in CSS/HTML (showing AI chat on left side and live resume preview on the right).
page_sections_instructions.social_proof: Ticker/Marquee of partner logos using provided unsplash abstract images. Very subtle opacity (opacity-50) and grayscale.
page_sections_instructions.how_it_works: Vertical timeline or 1x3 grid showing '1. Upload/Connect LinkedIn', '2. AI Rewrite & Optimize', '3. Export & Apply'. Use clean, 1px bordered cards.
page_sections_instructions.feature_grid: Bento Grid (TETRIS MODE). 12-column setup. Hero cell: 'ATS Scoring' (col-span-full md:col-span-8 row-span-2). Tall cell: 'AI Cover Letters' (col-span-4 row-span-2). Square cells for 'Templates' and 'Share Links'. Every cell must have an inner HTML UI snippet or icon.
page_sections_instructions.testimonials: Dense masonry or 1x3 grid of testimonials using provided portrait URLs. High contrast text.
page_sections_instructions.cta_section: Dark inverted section (bg-zinc-950 text-white) to break the rhythm. Massive H2. Single CTA. No credit card required micro-copy.

accessibility.rules: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes. Focus states must ring-2 ring-primary. Hover text color explicitly set.
